'''Condaris''' was a city in [[Aelgar]], part of the [[Ten Nations]]. It was Ogier-built.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Condaris}} It's current loction is unknown.

During the rebuilding after the [[Breaking of the World]], the [[Ogier]] built a [[Ways|waygate]] to Condaris.{{ref/book|6|20}}

In the [[List of Old Tongue words|Old Tongue]], it may be an amalgamation of ''conde'' (walk) and ''aris'' (harmony) to mean something like "the way of harmony". ''Conden'' is the verb "to walk" and ''conde'' are "walkers", so it may not be a stretch to translate the first half as the noun "walk", "path" or "way".
